title: Cái Kết Cho Tiểu Tam
style: Photorealistic live-action Vietnamese family melodrama film set in Hà Nội today; warm natural grade with soft golden kitchen light, muted old-quarter ochres, cool blue-grey dawn and rain, glossy cold tones for the wealthy world, natural skin texture, subtle 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field.
lighting: Naturalistic soft lighting: warm tungsten and charcoal-stove glow at home, cool grey-blue dawn light with yellow streetlamps on the old-quarter pavement, crisp cold daylight in the glass office and luxury apartment, wet neon reflections on rainy nights.

narrator.voice: Vietnamese woman about 50, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (giọng chuẩn Hà Nội Bắc Bộ, never Southern accent) with clear six tones, warm low alto with a slight husk, fast fluent heartfelt family-drama storytelling in one continuous breath, every word spoken once and clearly, no stutter, no repeated words

@Thu.name: Thu
@Thu.anchor: Thu, 34, hardworking wife who sells sticky rice at dawn; slim, lightly sun-tanned, long black hair in a low loose bun, gentle tired eyes, no makeup, work-roughened hands; faded light-blue cotton blouse with rolled sleeves, dark-brown trousers, dark-green cloth apron, plastic sandals.
@Thu.voice: woman of 34, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), soft warm mezzo, gentle but firm, speaking at a brisk, fluent pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@Tung.name: Tùng
@Tung.anchor: Tùng, 37, Thu's husband, newly rich construction company director; tall, slightly heavy, neatly gelled black hair, clean-shaven, heavy-lidded confident eyes; tailored charcoal-grey suit, white shirt open at the collar, gold wristwatch, polished black shoes.
@Tung.voice: man of 37, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), deep confident baritone, impatient and cold, speaking at a brisk, fast-clipped pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@Vy.name: Vy
@Vy.anchor: Vy, 24, Tùng's glamorous new secretary; slender and striking, long glossy wavy dark-brown hair, sharp feline eyes with winged eyeliner, red lipstick; fitted crimson sleeveless midi dress, thin gold necklace, beige high heels, small white handbag with no logo.
@Vy.voice: young woman of 24, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), sweet honeyed soprano that turns cold and sharp, speaking at a brisk, fast-clipped pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@BaNhan.name: Bà Nhàn
@BaNhan.anchor: Bà Nhàn, 70, Tùng's mother who lives with Thu; small and thin, white hair in a neat low bun, kind deeply wrinkled face; brown knitted cardigan over a grey blouse, black trousers, cloth slippers, carved bamboo walking stick.
@BaNhan.voice: old woman of 70, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), frail raspy voice, trembling but firm, speaking at a brisk pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@Na.name: Na
@Na.anchor: Na, 9, Thu and Tùng's daughter; small, round face, bright dark eyes, black hair in two short pigtails with red hair ties; white short-sleeve school shirt, navy pleated skirt, red scarf knotted at the neck, white canvas shoes.
@Na.voice: girl of 9, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), high clear child's voice, earnest, speaking at a brisk pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

@Khai.name: Khải
@Khai.anchor: Khải, 30, Vy's secret lover and partner in her scheme; lean, styled black undercut hair, thin moustache, sly half-smile; black slim-fit shirt with rolled sleeves, beige chinos, white sneakers, silver chain bracelet.
@Khai.voice: man of 30, strictly standard Hà Nội Northern accent (never Southern accent), smooth lazy tenor, sly and mocking, speaking at a brisk, fast-clipped pace, every word spoken once clearly without stutter

scenes.title: Người Đàn Bà Thức Dậy Trước Mặt Trời
scenes.time_label: 04:00 Rạng sáng, phố cổ Hà Nội (00:00–01:00)
scenes.location: Mái ngói phố cổ Hà Nội lúc rạng sáng (clip 1), rồi gian bếp tầng trệt căn nhà ống ba tầng trong một ngõ nhỏ.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt phía bàn ăn nhìn vào bếp: nồi đồ xôi bên trái, cầu thang dốc bên phải, kệ có camera nhỏ trên cao phía sau.
scenes.props: Nồi đồ xôi nhôm lớn, lá chuối, bát xôi, bàn thờ nhỏ với ba nén hương, gậy tre của bà Nhàn, chiếc camera nhỏ màu trắng trên kệ bếp.
scenes.setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Bốn giờ sáng, cả phố còn ngủ, con dâu tôi đã dậy đồ xôi. Còn thằng con giám đốc của tôi thì dạo này toàn về lúc gà gáy. Tôi nói trước nhé, nhà này sắp có biến.
clips.camera: 24mm aerial descending glide from the misty rooftops down to an upper-floor window
beats: High aerial view over the dark tiled roofs of the old quarter before dawn, thin mist drifting between the rooftops and yellow streetlamps glowing in the narrow alleys below.
The camera glides down past tangled overhead wires to a small upper-floor window, where @BaNhan swings open the wooden shutters and starts speaking, her wrinkled face lit by a lamp behind her.
@BaNhan keeps speaking as she leans on the sill with one hand on her bamboo walking stick, peering down into the dark empty alley with narrowed eyes.
@BaNhan says her last words, closes her mouth and lifts one eyebrow at the alley below, while steam glows gold from the lit kitchen window under her in the mist.
clips.sfx: a distant rooster crowing, a cold breeze, wooden shutters creaking, a soft hiss of steam below
clips.setting: Pre-dawn aerial over the tiled roofs of Hà Nội's old quarter: mist, yellow streetlamps, a few lit kitchen windows.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Mẹ đau lưng thì cứ nằm, xuống bếp sớm thế làm gì hả mẹ?

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Lưng mẹ đau mà còn dậy được, chứ anh chồng khoẻ như vâm của con thì vẫn ngáy khò khò trên gác kia kìa.

clips.camera: 35mm wide shot from the dining table toward the stove and the staircase, slow dolly-in
beats: The narrow kitchen before dawn, a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer puffing thick steam on the gas stove, banana leaves stacked on the wooden table, the steep tiled staircase dim beside it.
@Thu lifts the steamer lid in a cloud of steam and speaks over her shoulder to @BaNhan, who comes slowly down the last stairs on her bamboo walking stick with her mouth closed.
@BaNhan reaches the bottom step and answers @Thu with a dry crooked smile, raising the tip of her bamboo stick to point up at the ceiling, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed.
@BaNhan finishes, closes her mouth and sets the stick back down on the tiles, while @Thu presses her lips together to hold back a smile and turns back to the steam.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, the steamer lid rattling, slow footsteps on tiles, the tap of a bamboo stick, faint snoring from upstairs

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Hồi nó trắng tay, xôi của con là cao lương mỹ vị, giờ làm giám đốc rồi thì lại chê xôi là đồ nhà quê.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Mẹ nói khẽ thôi, giám đốc nghe thấy lại dỗi cả tuần đấy.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot across the wooden table, slow push-in
beats: @BaNhan lowers herself onto a low stool at the wooden table while @Thu sets a small bowl of warm sticky rice in front of her, both of them silent in the drifting steam.
@BaNhan speaks to @Thu with a loud sniff, pointing her chopsticks up the staircase, while @Thu folds a banana-leaf parcel across the table and listens with her mouth closed.
@BaNhan finishes with a scornful little snort, and @Thu tilts her head toward the staircase and begins answering in a low hush, while @BaNhan listens with her mouth closed.
@Thu finishes her hushed reply with a calm half-smile and closes her mouth, while @BaNhan rolls her eyes toward the ceiling and pops a ball of sticky rice into her mouth.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, chopsticks against a bowl, banana leaves rustling, faint snoring from upstairs

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Mẹ sống bảy mươi năm, chưa thấy ai đi họp mà về thơm nức mùi nước hoa đàn bà thế này.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Mẹ lại đùa. Khách của anh ấy chắc dùng nước hoa thay nước lã đấy mẹ.

clips.camera: 85mm medium close-up two-shot beside the chair back, slow rack focus
beats: @BaNhan leans over to a charcoal-grey suit jacket draped on the back of a chair and sniffs its collar twice, her nose wrinkling, while @Thu watches from the table, both of them silent.
@BaNhan holds the jacket collar out between two fingers like a dead fish and speaks to @Thu with a deadpan stare, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed, folding a banana leaf.
@BaNhan finishes and lets the collar drop, and @Thu answers her without looking up, smoothing the banana leaf with calm fingers and a faint dry half-smile, while @BaNhan listens.
@Thu says her last words and closes her mouth, and @BaNhan narrows her eyes and glances up at the small white home camera on the high kitchen shelf, her lips pressed tight.
clips.sfx: two loud sniffs, steam hissing, a banana leaf crackling, a rooster outside

scenes.title: Đôi Bông Tai Đã Bán
scenes.location: Gánh xôi nhỏ của Thu dưới chiếc ô bạc màu ở một góc vỉa hè phố cổ lúc hửng sáng; clip 2 ở bếp nhà Thu (bà Nhàn nói với camera).
scenes.axis: Máy quay trên vỉa hè nhìn vào gánh xôi: nồi xôi bên trái Thu, lòng đường và xe máy phía sau bên phải.
scenes.props: Thúng tre, nồi xôi bốc khói, lá chuối, ghế nhựa thấp, hộp bông tai nhung đỏ rỗng, điện thoại cũ của Thu, chiếc camera nhỏ màu trắng trên kệ bếp.
scenes.setting: Dawn on a Hà Nội old-quarter pavement corner: a small sticky-rice stall with a bamboo basket, a steaming pot and banana leaves under a big faded umbrella, low plastic stools, mopeds passing, blue-grey dawn light and yellow streetlamps.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Cô ơi, sương lạnh thế này, cháu biếu cô gói xôi nóng. Chồng cháu á? Giám đốc đấy cô ạ. Giám đốc thì ngồi ô tô, còn vợ giám đốc ngồi ghế nhựa bán xôi.
clips.camera: 24mm wide establishing shot, slow lateral track along the pavement
beats: A quiet old-quarter street corner at dawn, yellow streetlamps still glowing over the mist, a small sticky-rice stall steaming under a big faded umbrella beside empty low plastic stools.
@Thu lifts the lid of the steaming pot as an elderly woman street sweeper in an orange vest pauses by the stall with her bamboo broom, and @Thu starts speaking to her warmly.
@Thu keeps speaking with a bright wry smile as she wraps a warm banana-leaf parcel, tipping her head once toward the glass towers far down the street.
@Thu finishes, closes her mouth and pats the low plastic stool beside her with a little shrug, while the sweeper's shoulders shake with a silent chuckle as she takes the warm parcel in both hands.
clips.sfx: a moped passing, steam hissing, a bamboo broom sweeping the pavement
clips.extras: an elderly woman street sweeper in an orange vest with a bamboo broom

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Camera ơi, bà báo cáo nhé: đêm qua thằng Tùng hai giờ mới về, giày để ngược, nằm cười một mình với cái điện thoại. Mày ghi hết vào cho bà, có ngày bà cần đến mày.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow push-in toward the high kitchen shelf
beats: Early morning light in the narrow kitchen, the small white home camera on the high kitchen shelf blinking its tiny light above the empty dining table and a covered plate of banana-leaf parcels.
@BaNhan shuffles in on her bamboo walking stick, rises on tiptoe, taps the little white camera twice with the tip of her stick like knocking on a door, and starts speaking up to it.
@BaNhan keeps reporting up to the little camera in a conspiratorial murmur, counting the points off on her thin fingers and nodding to it as if it were answering her.
@BaNhan says her last words, closes her mouth and wags one bony finger at the little camera, then gives it a satisfied nod and lowers herself onto a stool.
clips.sfx: a bamboo stick tapping plastic twice, slippers shuffling on tiles, a stool creaking, a rooster outside
clips.setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Anh nhắn em đừng mang xôi lên công ty kẻo đối tác cười à? Vâng, em nhớ rồi. Ngày xưa em bán đôi bông tai cưới cho anh làm vốn, lúc ấy anh có cười đâu.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: The edge of the stall in grey dawn light, an old cracked smartphone lying face-down beside the bamboo basket with a faint glow leaking from its edges, steam drifting past the faded umbrella.
@Thu sits on the low stool, holds the old phone flat near her mouth with its glowing screen turned toward her and away from the camera, and starts speaking into it with a calm face.
@Thu keeps speaking as she draws a small empty red velvet earring box from her apron pocket with her free hand and thumbs it open, gazing at the bare velvet.
@Thu says her last words with a dry half-smile, closes her mouth and clicks the empty velvet box shut, her eyes bright but steady as steam curls past her face.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, the soft click of a box lid, a distant moped, dawn birdsong

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Xôi xéo nóng đây chị ơi! Chị thấy tòa nhà kính kia không? Chồng em ngồi tít trên đấy. Em cứ giữ cái gánh xôi này, lỡ mai anh ấy ngã xuống thì còn có chỗ mà đỡ.
clips.camera: 35mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the customer, slow crane up above the umbrella
beats: The steaming pot under the faded umbrella, banana-leaf parcels lined up in the bamboo basket, a parked moped at the curb in the brightening dawn.
@Thu stands behind the pot facing a woman customer in a pink raincoat, tucks an extra spoonful of fried shallots into a warm parcel and starts calling out with a bright grin.
@Thu hands the parcel across the basket and keeps speaking, tipping her chin toward the distant skyline as the camera begins to rise above the umbrella.
The camera rises above the faded umbrella to reveal glass towers catching the sunrise far away, while @Thu finishes, closes her mouth and pats the side of her steaming pot below.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, rustling banana leaves, mopeds passing, morning street noise rising
clips.extras: a woman customer in a pink raincoat

scenes.title: Ông Giám Đốc Mới Phất
scenes.location: Gian bếp kiêm phòng ăn tầng trệt căn nhà ống của Thu, buổi sáng.
scenes.axis: Cửa ra ngõ bên phải màn hình, cầu thang và gương treo bên trái, bàn ăn ở giữa.
scenes.props: Gương treo cạnh cầu thang, chiếc trống con màu đỏ của Na, bát xôi hành phi, cặp tài liệu da và điện thoại của Tùng.
scenes.setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Kính thưa quý vị, thay mặt ban giám đốc, tôi xin phát biểu. Chà, khuôn mặt sáng sủa thế này, ngày xưa đi giao xôi với vợ đúng là phí cả một thời trai trẻ.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in toward the mirror
beats: Morning light through the open front door of the narrow house, a small mirror hanging beside the steep tiled staircase, a leather briefcase resting on a stool.
@Tung steps in front of the mirror in his charcoal-grey suit, raises one palm to an imaginary audience and starts speaking in a grand booming tone to his own reflection.
@Tung keeps speaking as he leans close to the glass, smooths his gelled hair with both palms and turns his chin left and right to admire his profile.
@Tung finishes, closes his mouth, points a finger at his reflection and winks at it, then straightens his open white collar with a pleased little nod.
clips.sfx: a moped outside, morning birds, the mirror creaking on its nail

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Bố ơi, sao bố soi gương lâu hơn cả mẹ thế? Chiều nay bố đi xem con đánh trống nhé.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Bộ mặt giám đốc là bộ mặt công ty đấy con. Chiều bố họp, con bảo mẹ đi.

clips.camera: 40mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the girl at child height, slow dolly-in
beats: The foot of the steep staircase seen from child height, a small red toy drum with two wooden sticks resting on the bottom step in the morning light.
@Na hurries down the last steps in her school uniform, scoops up the little red drum and speaks up at @Tung, who keeps preening at the mirror with his mouth closed.
@Na finishes her question and hugs the drum, and @Tung answers her without turning from the mirror, flicking a speck off his lapel, while @Na listens with her mouth closed.
@Tung finishes, closes his mouth and picks up his briefcase, while @Na lowers the little red drum to her side and stares at his back, her lower lip tucked in.
clips.sfx: light footsteps on tiles, a soft drum tap, a briefcase clasp clicking, a moped outside

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Thôi, xôi với chả xôi, ăn vào hôi mồm, lát gặp đối tác người ta cười cho.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Hồi chưa làm giám đốc, anh ăn một lúc ba bát, đối tác duy nhất của anh là em đấy.

clips.camera: 35mm wide two-shot from the kitchen, slow lateral dolly
beats: The kitchen near the open front door, a bowl of steaming sticky rice heaped with golden fried shallots on the wooden dining table in a patch of morning sun.
@Thu holds the steaming bowl out toward @Tung at the doorway, and he waves one hand at it and speaks with a curl of his lip, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed.
@Thu draws the bowl back to her chest and answers @Tung evenly with a calm half-smile, looking him straight in the eye, while he listens with his mouth closed.
@Thu finishes, closes her mouth, sets the bowl on the table and sits down to it herself, while @Tung blinks twice, tugs his collar and walks out into the bright alley.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, a moped idling outside, footsteps leaving, a car door shutting outside

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Mẹ ơi, bố bảo đi họp, sao bố xịt nước hoa thơm như cô nào ấy?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Trẻ con biết gì. Chiều nay mẹ ngồi hàng đầu xem con đánh trống, còn bố chắc họp ở tiệm nước hoa.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot in the doorway, slow pull-back
beats: The open front door of the narrow house and the empty bright alley outside, a thin trail of steam curling from a bowl of sticky rice on the wooden table.
@Na walks up beside @Thu at the doorway hugging the little red drum, sniffs the air twice with her nose wrinkled and asks her a question, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed.
@Thu crouches to @Na's height, smooths her red scarf and answers her with a dry, slightly crooked smile, while @Na listens with her eyes on her mother's face.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, and @Na giggles silently behind her hand and gives the little red drum one soft tap, the two of them framed in the bright doorway.
clips.sfx: morning birds, a moped passing in the alley, a soft drum tap

scenes.title: Cô Thư Ký Váy Đỏ
scenes.location: Phòng giám đốc tường kính trên tầng cao một tòa tháp giữa Hà Nội.
scenes.axis: Bàn làm việc trắng ở giữa, cửa kính nhìn ra thành phố phía sau; cửa ra vào bên trái màn hình.
scenes.props: Bàn trắng, khung ảnh gia đình Thu – Tùng – Na, hộp cơm sơn mài đen bóng, mô hình tòa nhà, túi giấy mua mang về.
scenes.setting: A modern glass-walled director's office high in a Hà Nội tower: a large white desk with a family photo frame, a black leather chair, an architectural model of a residential tower, the city skyline beyond the windows.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Cơm quán dưới sảnh, bóc túi, đổ sang hộp sơn mài, rắc thêm tí hành là thành cơm em tự tay nấu. Đàn ông ấy mà, cứ thấy cái hộp đẹp là tin sái cổ.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow dolly-in on the white desk
beats: A bright glass-walled office high above the city, the large white desk gleaming in cold morning light, with a glossy black lacquered lunch box sitting open beside a framed family photo of Thu, Tùng and Na.
@Vy stands at the desk in her crimson dress, tears open a plain paper takeaway bag with no logo and starts murmuring to herself with a wicked little grin.
@Vy keeps murmuring as she tips the takeaway rice and braised pork from the bag into the lacquered box, then sprinkles a pinch of chopped green onion on top with a flourish.
@Vy finishes, closes her red lips and presses the lacquered lid shut, then drops the crumpled paper bag into the waste bin under the desk without looking.
clips.sfx: paper tearing, rice sliding into a box, a lid clicking shut, air conditioning hum

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Em nấu đấy à? Ngon thật, mà sao vị giống hệt cơm quán dưới sảnh thế nhỉ?

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Thì em học lỏm công thức của quán ấy đấy anh, ai bảo anh mê cơm ở đấy cơ.

clips.camera: 24mm wide two-shot of the office, slow lateral dolly
beats: The white desk with a glossy black lacquered lunch box resting beside a framed family photo of Thu, Tùng and Na, the city skyline blurred in the glass behind.
@Tung sits in the black leather chair with chopsticks over the lunch box, swallows a bite and speaks to @Vy with his eyes narrowed at the food, while she stands by the desk with her mouth closed.
@Vy freezes for a heartbeat with her smile stuck in place, then answers @Tung in a honey-sweet voice, fluttering her lashes, while he listens with his mouth closed.
@Vy finishes and closes her red lips, and @Tung shrugs, nods and digs back into the lunch box, while @Vy lets out a slow silent breath behind her smile.
clips.sfx: chopsticks clicking on lacquer, chair leather creaking, air conditioning hum

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Anh tài giỏi thế này, sao tối nào cũng phải về ngồi ngửi mùi khói bếp hả anh?

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Em nói đúng, giám đốc gì mà người lúc nào cũng ám mùi lá chuối.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow rack focus between them
beats: @Vy perches on the corner of the white desk and leans toward @Tung as he sets the chopsticks down, straightening his open white collar with one fingertip, both of them silent.
@Vy speaks to @Tung in a soft coaxing voice, tilting her head so her wavy hair falls over one shoulder, while @Tung listens with his mouth closed.
@Vy finishes, and @Tung gives his own sleeve one quick sniff, lowers it with a sour grimace and answers her, while @Vy listens with a sympathetic pout.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, frowning at his sleeve, while @Vy hides a small cold smirk behind her hand, the skyline glittering behind them.
clips.sfx: chair leather creaking, a long sniff, faint traffic far below

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Ảnh gia đình ba người, đẹp nhỉ. Chị Thu ơi, chị cứ ở nhà đồ xôi cho mỏi tay đi, còn ông chồng giám đốc của chị, em xin phép nhận nuôi hộ nhé.
clips.camera: 35mm medium shot, slow lateral dolly from the glass wall to the desk corner
beats: The empty office in cold city light, the white desk bare except for a framed family photo of Thu, Tùng and Na and a glossy black lacquered lunch box scraped clean.
@Vy strolls back in through the glass door, stops at the corner of the desk, picks up the family photo and starts speaking to it in a sugary baby voice.
@Vy keeps whispering to the photo, tapping the glass over the wife's face with one red fingernail and tilting her head in mock sympathy.
@Vy says her last words, closes her mouth and lays the frame face down on the desk with one manicured finger, her smile reflected cold in the glossy white surface.
clips.sfx: high heels on a polished floor, a fingernail tapping glass, a soft tap of a frame on the desk

scenes.title: Người Tình Bí Mật
scenes.time_label: 12:00 Trưa, quán cà phê kín đáo (04:00–05:00)
scenes.location: Một quán cà phê sang trọng, kín đáo, cách tòa nhà văn phòng ba con phố.
scenes.axis: Bàn trong góc khuất bên phải màn hình sau chậu cau cảnh, cửa sổ cao nhìn ra phố cây xanh bên trái.
scenes.props: Ghế bành nhung, đèn đồng, bàn đá cẩm thạch, hai tách cà phê, kính râm và điện thoại của Vy, điện thoại và vòng tay bạc của Khải.
scenes.setting: An upscale café at noon: velvet armchairs, brass lamps, marble tables, tall windows facing a leafy street.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Anh Khải, anh ngồi thụp sau chậu cau làm gì, trông như đi ăn trộm thế?

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Thì mình đi ăn trộm thật còn gì, mà trộm hẳn một cái công ty cơ em.

clips.camera: 24mm wide establishing shot, slow pan across the room
beats: A hushed upscale café at noon, sunlight through tall windows onto velvet armchairs and marble tables, a tall potted areca palm half-hiding a corner table under a brass lamp.
@Vy walks in sliding her dark sunglasses down her nose, spots @Khai crouched low behind the potted palm and speaks to him with one eyebrow raised, while he stays silent.
@Khai pokes his head out between the palm fronds with a sly grin and answers @Vy in a lazy whisper, while she listens with her red lips pressed together.
@Khai finishes, closes his mouth and slides up into the velvet armchair behind the palm, smoothing his black shirt, while @Vy shakes her head and sits down opposite him.
clips.sfx: a café door chime, soft clinking of cups, palm fronds rustling

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Ngồi xuống đi em, kẻo có người nhìn thấy. Thế nào, lão giám đốc cắn câu chưa?

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Cắn câu à? Lão nuốt luôn cả cần câu rồi anh. Nửa năm nữa lão bỏ vợ, sang tên nhà cho em.

clips.camera: 35mm over-the-shoulder shot through the palm fronds, gentle dolly
beats: @Khai parts the palm fronds with two fingers to peek out at the room, then lets them fall back and leans toward @Vy across the marble table, both of them silent.
@Khai speaks to @Vy in a low lazy voice with a sly half-smile, tapping one finger on the marble, while @Vy slips off her sunglasses and listens with her mouth closed.
@Vy answers @Khai with a cool crooked smile, stirring her coffee slowly, the sweetness gone from her face, while he listens with his mouth closed.
@Vy finishes and sets the spoon on the saucer with a precise click, while @Khai raises both eyebrows and sits back slowly, his silver chain bracelet catching the lamplight.
clips.sfx: cups clinking, a low café murmur, a spoon circling porcelain

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Nhưng nhỡ lão phát hiện ra có anh thì sao? Đàn ông ngu đến mấy cũng có lúc tỉnh đấy em.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Lão ký hợp đồng còn chẳng thèm đọc, thì làm sao mà đọc nổi em.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: Two coffee cups steaming on the marble table behind the potted areca palm, a pair of dark sunglasses and a phone lying face-down beside them in the brass lamplight.
@Khai leans in over the cups and speaks to @Vy in a hushed voice, glancing twice over the palm fronds toward the windows, while @Vy listens with her mouth closed.
@Khai finishes his worry, and @Vy answers him with a slow curl of her red lips, her winged eyes cold above the rim of her coffee cup, while he listens with his mouth closed.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, taking a sip of coffee, while @Khai lets out a long breath and tugs at his collar, glancing at the palm fronds once more.
clips.sfx: a low café murmur, a cup set on a saucer, a car passing outside

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Đến lúc lão tỉnh ra thì chỉ còn cái bụng phệ với hai bàn tay trắng.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Thế thì cụng ly, chúc mừng bà chủ tương lai. À mà em trả tiền nhé, anh lại quên ví.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow lateral dolly
beats: @Vy sets her coffee cup down and leans forward toward @Khai, her red nails tapping the rim, both of them silent in the warm lamplight behind the palm.
@Vy speaks to @Khai in a low cold voice, her winged eyes narrowing above a thin smile, while @Khai listens with his mouth closed.
@Khai lifts his coffee cup toward her in a small toast and answers with a lazy grin, then pats his empty trouser pockets with a sheepish shrug, while @Vy listens.
@Khai finishes and closes his mouth, and @Vy rolls her eyes at the ceiling, takes a folded banknote from her small white handbag and sets it on the marble with a sigh.
clips.sfx: porcelain cups clinking, a low café murmur, a handbag clasp clicking

scenes.title: Sợi Tóc Trên Áo Chồng
scenes.location: Gian bếp tầng trệt căn nhà ống lúc gần nửa đêm, chỉ một bóng đèn vàng và bếp than.
scenes.axis: Bàn ăn và ghế ở giữa, cầu thang dốc bên phải màn hình, bếp than bên trái.
scenes.props: Áo sơ mi trắng của Tùng có vệt son đỏ và sợi tóc nâu xoăn, cà vạt lụa, đôi giày đen, bếp than.
scenes.setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Lại nước hoa. Loại này đắt tiền đấy, thằng Tùng có bao giờ mua cho con lọ nào đâu.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Mẹ đưa con giặt, mai anh ấy còn mặc đi họp. Họp với ai thì con chưa biết.

clips.camera: 35mm wide shot, slow dolly-in across the kitchen
beats: The dim kitchen at night lit by one warm bulb, the charcoal stove glowing low, a white dress shirt and a loosened silk tie draped over a dining chair, black shoes askew beneath it.
@BaNhan lifts the white shirt off the chair on the tip of her bamboo walking stick, sniffs it and speaks with a sour pucker, while @Thu comes down the last stairs listening with her mouth closed.
@BaNhan finishes, and @Thu lifts the shirt off the stick and answers her calmly, folding it over her arm, while @BaNhan listens with her mouth closed and one eyebrow raised.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, then lifts the collar toward the bulb and stops, her brows drawing together, while @BaNhan's hand tightens on her bamboo stick.
clips.sfx: the charcoal stove crackling, soft footsteps on the stairs, fabric rustling, a dog barking far away

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Mẹ ơi, son đỏ trên cổ áo, sợi tóc xoăn màu nâu, mà tóc con thì thẳng và đen.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Tóc xoăn, son đỏ, chắc không phải ông khách hàng nào đâu nhỉ.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up on the collar and their faces, slow rack focus
beats: @Thu turns the white collar toward the bulb, revealing a smudge of bright red lipstick on the fabric, while @BaNhan leans in to look, both of them silent.
@Thu lifts a single long wavy brown hair from the shoulder of the shirt, holds it up in the warm light and speaks to @BaNhan in an even voice, while @BaNhan listens.
@Thu finishes, and @BaNhan squints at the brown hair, then answers @Thu in a flat deadpan voice without blinking, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, and @Thu lets the hair drift to the floor and folds the shirt into a neat square, her jaw set and her eyes dry.
clips.sfx: the stove crackling, a slow breath, a moth tapping the bulb

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Anh Tùng, vệt son đỏ trên cổ áo anh là của ai? Anh nói thật đi.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Thang máy công ty đông người, ai va vào chả dính, cô đừng có làm ầm lên giữa đêm.

clips.camera: 35mm wide two-shot from the kitchen doorway, slow dolly
beats: The foot of the steep staircase in the dim warm light, the wooden dining table between the stairs and the glowing charcoal stove, the kitchen empty and still.
@Tung appears on the lower stairs in his suit, and @Thu holds up the folded white shirt toward him from across the table and speaks in a steady voice, while he listens.
@Tung rolls his eyes, steps down onto the tiles and answers @Thu flatly with a lazy wave of his hand, not looking at the shirt, while she listens with her mouth closed.
@Tung finishes, closes his mouth, turns his back and climbs the stairs again, while @Thu stays across the table with the shirt still raised and one eyebrow lifted.
clips.sfx: the stove crackling, a creaking stair, heavy footsteps on the stairs

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Thang máy công ty anh chắc đông lắm, đông đến mức son người ta dính đúng cổ áo, tóc người ta vắt đúng vai anh. Được, em không làm ầm. Em cứ im lặng mà xem anh diễn đến đâu.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot from the kitchen, slow push-in
beats: The bottom of the steep tiled staircase in the dim kitchen, the warm bulb swaying slightly on its cord and the charcoal stove reduced to faint embers.
@Thu sits down on the lowest stair with the white shirt in her lap and starts speaking quietly toward the dark top of the stairs, her face calm.
@Thu keeps speaking as she rubs the red smudge on the collar with her thumb, then folds the shirt into a perfect square on her knees.
@Thu says her last words with a calm half-smile, closes her mouth and sets the folded shirt on the step beside her, her eyes on the dark landing above.
clips.sfx: embers ticking, the bulb cord creaking, a distant dog bark

scenes.title: Chuyến Công Tác Đà Nẵng
scenes.time_label: Chiều tà, khu nghỉ dưỡng biển (06:00–07:00)
scenes.location: Hồ bơi vô cực của một khu nghỉ dưỡng sang trọng ven biển lúc hoàng hôn; clip 4 ở bếp nhà Thu ban đêm.
scenes.axis: Hai ghế dài trắng bên mép hồ bơi, biển phía sau bên trái màn hình; ở nhà Thu, bàn ăn ở giữa, ghế trống của Tùng bên phải.
scenes.props: Ghế dài trắng, hai ly nước cam, điện thoại của Tùng, chiếc bánh sinh nhật nhỏ có một ngọn nến, ghế trống của Tùng.
scenes.setting: Sunset at a luxury seaside resort: an infinity pool terrace with white loungers, palm trees, the sea glowing orange.

clips.speaker: @Tung
clips.line: Thu à, anh đang họp căng lắm, phải ba ngày nữa mới về, sinh nhật em anh không kịp rồi. Tiếng gì à? À, máy lạnh phòng họp kêu đấy em, công ty to thì máy lạnh cũng to.
clips.camera: 24mm aerial slow descending orbit down to the pool terrace
beats: High aerial view of a luxury seaside resort at sunset, palm trees swaying above a long curve of golden beach and a calm orange sea.
The camera sweeps down to the infinity pool terrace, where @Tung stands in his full charcoal-grey suit beside a white lounger, a phone pressed to his ear, speaking in a solemn businesslike voice.
@Tung keeps speaking into the phone as a big wave rolls loudly onto the beach below, and he quickly cups his free hand over the phone and turns his back to the sea.
@Tung finishes, closes his mouth, lowers the phone and tosses it onto the lounger with a smug grin, the pool edge melting into the shining sea behind him.
clips.sfx: gentle waves, one loud wave rolling onto the sand, palm fronds rustling, distant seabirds

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Máy lạnh phòng họp mà có cả sóng biển với nước cam hả anh?

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Vợ anh chỉ biết xôi với chợ, anh bảo sóng biển là máy lạnh thì cô ấy cũng tin.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot, slow lateral dolly along the pool
beats: Two white loungers at the edge of the infinity pool, a small table between them holding two glasses of orange juice, the sea glowing orange beyond.
@Vy reclines on one lounger in her crimson dress, lifts her glass of orange juice in a mock toast and teases @Tung with a smirk as he sits beside her, while he listens with his mouth closed.
@Tung answers @Vy with a lazy grin, jerking a thumb toward the sea behind him, while @Vy listens with a closed-mouth smile.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @Vy clinks her glass against his, the two of them grinning and gazing out at the orange sea.
clips.sfx: gentle waves, glasses clinking, a soft breeze

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Anh ơi, thế bao giờ em mới được đứng cạnh anh trong tấm ảnh gia đình trên bàn ấy?

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Về Hà Nội anh tính. Ảnh thì dễ thôi em, ra hiệu ảnh chụp lại là xong.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow push-in
beats: @Vy turns toward @Tung on the lounger, resting her chin on her hand, the sunset gilding her wavy hair, both of them silent.
@Vy speaks to @Tung in a sweet coaxing voice, her winged eyes half-lowered, tracing a small square frame in the air with one finger, while @Tung listens with his mouth closed.
@Vy finishes, and @Tung waves a careless hand and answers her with a shrug, his eyes on the darkening sea, while she listens with her mouth closed.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @Vy rests her head lightly on his shoulder, her sweet smile turning cold where he cannot see it as the last sunlight fades.
clips.sfx: waves lapping, a soft breeze through the palms

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Mẹ ơi, bố bảo máy lạnh kêu, nhưng con nghe rõ tiếng sóng biển mà.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Ừ, máy lạnh nhà giàu kêu như sóng biển đấy con. Thôi, thổi nến đi, điều ước năm nay mẹ nhường con.

clips.camera: 40mm over-the-shoulder shot across the birthday cake, slow push-in
beats: The wooden dining table in the dim kitchen at night, a small round birthday cake with one lit candle, three bowls and one empty chair pulled out at the far end.
@Na kneels on her stool across the cake from @Thu and speaks to her with a puzzled frown, cupping one hand behind her ear, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed.
@Thu answers @Na with a dry little smile, her eyes glistening in the candlelight as she slides the cake toward her daughter, while @Na listens with her mouth closed.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, and @Na shuts her eyes and clasps her small hands over the candle, while @Thu glances at the empty chair across the table.
clips.sfx: a faint candle hiss, soft rain on the roof, a moth tapping the bulb
clips.setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

scenes.title: Bức Ảnh Lúc Nửa Đêm
scenes.location: Gian bếp tầng trệt căn nhà ống lúc nửa đêm; clip cuối ở chiếu nghỉ cầu thang.
scenes.axis: Bàn ăn ở giữa, bếp bên trái, cầu thang bên phải màn hình dẫn lên chiếu nghỉ.
scenes.props: Điện thoại của Tùng (màn hình chỉ phát sáng, không chữ), chìa khóa xe, bàn ăn gỗ, gậy tre của bà Nhàn.
scenes.setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Anh Tuấn kế toán nhắn lúc nửa đêm: nhớ anh quá. Còn gửi cả ảnh. Kế toán gì mà tóc xoăn, váy đỏ, lại tựa đầu vào vai chồng người ta thế này hả anh Tuấn?
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, slow push-in on the table
beats: The dining table in the dim kitchen at night, a sleek black smartphone lying face-down beside a car key, buzzing on the wood as a cold glow leaks from under its edges.
@Thu steps over from the stove, picks up the buzzing phone with its glowing screen turned toward her and away from the camera, and starts reading aloud in a flat dry voice.
@Thu keeps speaking as she tilts the phone in the cold light, one eyebrow climbing higher with each word, her other hand settling on her hip.
@Thu says her last words, closes her mouth and looks up from the glowing phone toward the staircase with a calm, icy half-smile.
clips.sfx: a phone buzzing on wood, a dripping tap, a heavy silence

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Cô lục điện thoại của tôi à? Thế là xâm phạm đời tư đấy!

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Đời tư à? Thế anh xâm phạm cả cái nhà này, cả mẹ con em, thì gọi là gì hả anh?

clips.camera: 35mm wide two-shot from the stove, slow dolly
beats: The steep staircase and the dining table in the dim kitchen, a phone's cold glow the brightest light in the room, the charcoal stove ticking low.
@Tung strides down the last stairs and stops on the far side of the table, pointing at the phone in @Thu's hand as he speaks sharply, while she listens with her mouth closed.
@Thu sets the glowing phone face-down on the table between them and answers @Tung evenly with her chin lifted, while he listens with his jaw working.
@Thu finishes, closes her mouth and folds her arms, while @Tung opens and shuts his empty hands at his sides, the wooden table still between them.
clips.sfx: heavy footsteps on tiles, a phone set down on wood, the tap dripping

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Tôi chán cái nhà này rồi, chán mùi xôi, chán cả cô.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Anh chán mùi xôi, nhưng hồi anh trắng tay, chính gánh xôi với đôi bông tai cưới em bán đi đã nuôi anh thành giám đốc đấy.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot across the table, slow push-in
beats: @Tung picks his phone up off the table and slips it into his trouser pocket without looking at @Thu, both of them silent under the swaying bulb.
@Tung speaks coldly to @Thu with a flick of his hand toward the steamer by the stove, his nose wrinkled, and then @Thu begins answering in a low steady voice while he listens.
@Thu keeps answering @Tung with her eyes level and dry, tapping one finger on the wooden table with each phrase, while @Tung listens with his jaw set.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, and @Tung turns away without a word and climbs the stairs two at a time, leaving @Thu alone at the table under the swaying bulb.
clips.sfx: footsteps on the stairs, a door shutting hard upstairs, the tap dripping

clips.speaker: @BaNhan
clips.line: Thằng này hết thuốc chữa thật rồi. Camera ơi, ở dưới ấy mày có ghi được không? Không ghi được thì bà nhớ hộ. Bà già thật, nhưng trí nhớ còn tốt hơn mày đấy.
clips.camera: 50mm medium low-angle shot up the stairwell, slow push-in
beats: A dim tiled stair landing in darkness, a faint warm glow rising from the kitchen below and a closed door above.
@BaNhan stands on the landing in her brown cardigan gripping her bamboo walking stick, shakes her head at the closed door above and starts speaking in a sharp whisper.
@BaNhan leans over the railing and keeps whispering down toward a tiny green light glowing far below in the kitchen, wagging one bony finger at it.
@BaNhan says her last words, closes her mouth and taps her own temple twice with one finger, giving a firm little nod in the faint light.
clips.sfx: a door closing upstairs, the faint drip of a tap below, the railing creaking
clips.setting: Night on the dim tiled stair landing of the tube house, a faint light from the kitchen below.

scenes.title: Bé Ba Ghé Gánh Xôi
scenes.location: Gánh xôi của Thu ở góc vỉa hè phố cổ Hà Nội lúc rạng sáng.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt phía ngoài phố nhìn vào gánh xôi; Thu đứng sau nồi xôi bên phải, Vy đứng phía vỉa hè bên trái, xe sang đỗ sát lề phía sau Vy.
scenes.props: Nồi xôi bốc khói, mẹt tre, lá chuối, xe sang đen không logo, tờ tiền gấp, kính râm và túi xách trắng của Vy.
scenes.setting: Dawn on a Hà Nội old-quarter pavement corner: a small sticky-rice stall with a bamboo basket, a steaming pot and banana leaves under a big faded umbrella, low plastic stools, mopeds passing, blue-grey dawn light and yellow streetlamps.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Thì ra bà vợ bán xôi của anh Tùng ngồi ở cái góc này. Mặt mộc, tạp dề, tay thì chai sạn. Mình còn đeo kính râm cho đỡ chói mắt, hóa ra phí cả cái kính.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow tilt up from the wet curb to her face
beats: A black luxury sedan with no badge glides to a stop at the curb of the misty old-quarter corner, its glossy rear door swinging open onto the wet pavement under a yellow streetlamp.
A beige high heel steps down onto the pavement and the camera tilts up to @Vy in her crimson dress and dark sunglasses as she starts murmuring to herself, her red lips clearly visible.
@Vy lowers the sunglasses to the tip of her nose with one finger and keeps murmuring, eyeing the small sticky-rice stall across the pavement from top to bottom with one eyebrow raised.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her red lips in a smirk, slides the sunglasses back up with one fingertip and starts walking toward the steaming stall, the car door left open behind her.
clips.sfx: a car engine idling, a car door opening, high heels clicking on wet pavement, mopeds passing

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Chị ơi, cho em một gói xôi xéo, nghe nói ngày xưa anh Tùng mê xôi của chị lắm cơ.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Váy đỏ, tóc xoăn, giọng ngọt như rót mật. Cô là kế toán Tuấn đấy à?

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot in profile across the stall, slow push-in
beats: Banana leaves and a round bamboo tray of steaming sticky rice on the stall table under the big faded umbrella, wisps of steam drifting through the blue dawn light.
@Vy walks up to the stall in her crimson dress and dark sunglasses and speaks sweetly across the steam with a tilted head, while @Thu keeps folding a banana-leaf parcel with her mouth closed.
@Vy finishes and closes her red lips, and @Thu slowly looks up from the parcel, lets her eyes travel over the crimson dress and the wavy hair, and answers calmly with a faint dry half-smile.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, going back to tying the parcel, while @Vy's sweet smile stays frozen in place and her sunglasses slide halfway down her nose.
clips.sfx: steam hissing from the pot, high heels stopping on wet pavement, a moped passing, banana leaves rustling

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Chị giữ được cái bếp, nhưng giữ không nổi ông chồng đâu chị ạ.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Em thích thì cứ lấy, chị không giữ đâu. Nhưng anh ấy ngáy to lắm, nhớ mua bông nhét tai nhé.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot across the steaming pot, slow push-in
beats: @Vy takes off her sunglasses and rests one hand on the edge of the stall table, looking @Thu up and down, while @Thu ladles sticky rice onto a banana leaf, both with their mouths closed.
@Vy speaks to @Thu in a sweet cold voice with a thin smile, her winged eyes narrowing, while @Thu keeps ladling the rice with steady hands and her mouth closed.
@Vy finishes and closes her lips, and @Thu wraps the parcel without looking up and answers in an easy, kindly tone with a calm half-smile, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, setting the neat parcel down right in front of @Vy, who blinks twice with her lips pressed shut and her smile sagging at one corner.
clips.sfx: steam hissing, a ladle tapping the pot rim, a moped horn far away

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Tiền xôi đây, khỏi trả lại. Chị giữ lấy mà mua kem dưỡng da tay nhé.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Cảm ơn em, chị mua thêm gạo nếp. Tay chị thô thật, nhưng chưa lấy của ai cái gì bao giờ.

clips.camera: 35mm medium shot across the stall, slow dolly back
beats: @Vy takes a folded banknote from her small white handbag and drops it onto the bamboo tray of sticky rice, while @Thu stands behind the pot watching, both with their mouths closed.
@Vy slips her dark sunglasses back on and speaks to @Thu with a sugary smile, flicking her eyes at @Thu's work-roughened hands, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed.
@Vy finishes and closes her lips, and @Thu picks up the banknote, smooths it flat and tucks it into her green apron pocket, answering evenly with a calm half-smile.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth and calmly wraps the next parcel, while @Vy's red lips press into a thin line and she turns on her heel toward the parked black car.
clips.sfx: a banknote rustling, steam hissing, high heels clicking away, a car door shutting

scenes.title: Mâm Cơm Đòi Ly Hôn
scenes.location: Bếp và bàn ăn tầng trệt nhà ống của Thu trong ngõ phố cổ, buổi tối.
scenes.axis: Máy quay ở phía bếp than nhìn dọc bàn ăn; Tùng ngồi đầu bàn bên trái, Thu ngồi bên phải, bà Nhàn ở góc bàn gần chân cầu thang.
scenes.props: Mâm cơm đủ món (cá kho, rau muống xào, canh cua, nồi cơm), bát đũa, muôi canh, gậy tre của bà Nhàn.
scenes.setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Anh ngồi xuống ăn đi, cá kho với canh cua anh thích đây.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Bộ vest mấy chục triệu của tôi giờ ám toàn mùi cá kho. Tôi chịu hết nổi rồi, mình ly hôn đi.

clips.camera: 35mm medium two-shot along the dinner table, slow glide
beats: A wooden dining table under one warm bulb set with braised fish, stir-fried morning glory, crab soup and a pot of rice, steam curling up beside neat bowls and chopsticks.
@Thu sets a steaming bowl of crab soup in front of @Tung as he sits down in his charcoal suit, and speaks warmly to him, while he keeps his mouth closed.
@Tung lifts his own suit sleeve to his nose, sniffs it with a grimace and answers @Thu flatly, laying his chopsticks across the untouched bowl, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, leaning back with his arms folded, while @Thu stands motionless beside the table, the soup ladle frozen in her hand above the pot.
clips.sfx: a charcoal stove crackling, porcelain bowls clinking, chopsticks laid across a bowl

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Anh định bỏ cả mẹ con em lẫn mâm cơm này để đi theo kế toán Tuấn đấy à?

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Cô ấy hiểu tôi hơn cô nhiều. Mà Tuấn gì mà Tuấn, người ta tên là Vy!

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot across the corner of the table, slow push-in
beats: @Thu slowly lowers the ladle into the soup pot and sits down at the corner of the table, her eyes level on @Tung, who stays leaning back, both of them with their mouths closed.
@Thu speaks to @Tung in a quiet even voice with one eyebrow lifting, her hands folded on the table, while he listens with his mouth closed and his jaw tight.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, and @Tung points one finger hard at the tabletop and answers loudly, his face and lips clearly visible, while she watches him with her mouth closed.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, his raised finger slowly curling back as his eyes widen at what he just blurted out, while @Thu tilts her head with a calm closed half-smile.
clips.sfx: the soup bowl clinking, rain beginning on the roof, the charcoal stove ticking

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Mẹ đừng nhìn con như thế. Con lớn rồi, lại còn là giám đốc, chuyện nhà con tự lo.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Giám đốc à? Giám đốc mà ăn cơm vợ nấu bao nhiêu năm, chưa rửa nổi một cái bát.

clips.camera: 28mm wide shot from the foot of the staircase along the table, locked-off
beats: A carved bamboo walking stick leaning against a low stool at the corner of the dinner table, a pot of crab soup with an aluminum ladle resting in it under the warm bulb.
@Tung stands up from the head of the table, buttons his suit jacket and speaks down to @BaNhan in a lofty tone, while she sits glaring at him with her mouth closed.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @BaNhan rises on her bamboo stick, lifts the soup ladle out of the pot like a judge's gavel and answers him in a flat deadpan voice.
@BaNhan finishes speaking and closes her mouth, the dripping ladle still raised from across the table, while @Tung stands stiff with his lips pressed shut and one hand frozen on his jacket button.
clips.sfx: a stool scraping on tiles, broth dripping from a ladle, rain on the roof

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Nói thêm một câu nữa là mẹ cất nồi canh cua, cho giám đốc nhịn đói.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Thì con nhịn, ra ngoài thiếu gì nhà hàng. Con quyết rồi, tuần này con dọn đi.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot across the table, slow push-in
beats: @BaNhan lowers the ladle back into the crab soup and rests one hand on the pot handle, while @Tung stands across the table straightening his cuffs, both of them with their mouths closed.
@BaNhan speaks to @Tung in a dry raspy deadpan, tapping the rim of the soup pot once with her finger, while he listens with his mouth closed and his chin raised.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, and @Tung picks up his car keys from the table and answers her stiffly without meeting her eyes, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, turning his shoulder toward the front door, while @BaNhan calmly slides the whole pot of crab soup to her own end of the table, her lips shut.
clips.sfx: rain on the roof, a walking stick tapping the tiled floor, a heavy pot sliding across wood, car keys jingling

scenes.title: Nước Mắt Bên Bếp Than
scenes.location: Bếp than tầng trệt nhà Thu lúc nửa đêm.
scenes.axis: Máy quay từ phía chân cầu thang nhìn vào bếp than; Thu ngồi ghế thấp bên trái bếp, Na đi xuống từ cầu thang bên phải.
scenes.props: Bếp than đất nung, quạt nan, chậu nhôm ngâm gạo nếp, ghế nhựa thấp, bóng đèn vàng, tạp dề xanh của Thu.
scenes.setting: Night inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a dim ground-floor kitchen lit by one warm bulb and a charcoal stove, a wooden dining table, a steep tiled staircase, a small white home camera with a tiny green light on a high kitchen shelf.

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Thôi, không được khóc to. Mẹ mà thức thì lại lo, con bé mà thấy thì nó sợ. Khóc thì cứ khóc, nhưng nước mắt có làm chín được nồi xôi nào đâu.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow tilt up from the basin of soaking rice to her face
beats: A glowing clay charcoal stove in the dark kitchen beside an aluminum basin of soaking sticky rice and a low plastic stool, a single warm bulb swaying slightly overhead.
@Thu sits on the low stool rinsing the soaked rice with both hands and whispers to herself in a thin voice, a tear dropping into the basin, her face and lips lit orange.
@Thu glances up toward the dark staircase and keeps whispering, then wipes her cheek with the back of her wet wrist, a small wry smile tugging at her lips.
@Thu finishes whispering and closes her mouth, pours fresh water over the rice and stirs it with steady hands, her chin set in the orange glow of the stove.
clips.sfx: charcoal crackling, water swishing in a basin, crickets outside, a faint snore from upstairs

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Mẹ ơi, người ta bảo bố có bé ba, bé ba là gì hả mẹ? Có phải em bé thứ ba nhà mình không?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Không phải đâu con. Nhà mình chỉ có một em bé thôi, là con đấy.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot from the side of the stove, slow dolly-in
beats: The bottom of the steep tiled staircase in the dim kitchen, the clay stove glowing orange beside the basin of soaking rice and an empty low plastic stool.
@Na pads down in her school clothes, sits on the stool beside @Thu and asks her a question with wide earnest eyes, while @Thu turns her wet face to her, mouth closed.
@Na keeps asking with a small frown of concentration, and when she finishes and closes her mouth, @Thu bursts into a laugh through her tears and answers, tapping the tip of @Na's nose.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, wiping her eyes with her wrist and pulling @Na against her side, while @Na grins up at her with a closed mouth in the orange glow.
clips.sfx: small footsteps on tiles, charcoal crackling, a soft laugh through a sniffle

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Thế con là bé nhất, bé nhất được ra lệnh: mẹ không được khóc nữa, mai con dậy gói xôi với mẹ.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Vâng, mẹ tuân lệnh sếp nhỏ. Mẹ còn con, còn bà, mẹ không gục được đâu.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot of mother and daughter, slow arc around the stove
beats: @Na reaches up and wipes the tears off @Thu's cheeks with her small thumbs, then sits up very straight on the stool, both of them with their mouths closed.
@Na holds up one stern little finger like a tiny boss and speaks earnestly to @Thu, her face and lips clearly visible, while @Thu listens with glistening eyes and her mouth closed.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, and @Thu gives her a small two-finger salute at her brow and answers with a trembling smile, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, hooking her little finger around @Na's, both of them smiling with closed mouths in the orange glow of the stove.
clips.sfx: charcoal crackling, rain easing outside

clips.speaker: @Thu
clips.line: Cháy lên nào. Than sắp tàn mà quạt mãi còn đỏ lại, chẳng lẽ người lại thua cục than. Từ mai mẹ con mình không chờ ai thương nữa, mình tự thương lấy mình.
clips.camera: 50mm medium shot, low angle from beside the clay stove, slow tilt up to her face
beats: Grey charcoal embers inside a clay stove in the dark kitchen, a faint orange glow pulsing between them beside a woven bamboo hand fan lying on the tiles.
@Thu kneels beside the stove, picks up the woven bamboo hand fan and fans the coals, speaking firmly to herself as the embers start to redden, her face and lips lit by the glow.
@Thu keeps fanning in steady strokes as she speaks, a dry little smile aimed at the stubborn coals, her eyes fixed on the flames as they flare bright orange.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, fanning steadily with her chin raised, the fierce orange flames filling the bottom of the frame and lighting her dry eyes.
clips.sfx: charcoal crackling and flaring, a bamboo fan swishing, a soft whoosh of air

scenes.title: Hai Vạch Hồng
scenes.location: Căn hộ cao cấp trên cao Tùng thuê cho Vy, buổi sáng.
scenes.axis: Máy quay từ phía sofa nhìn về đảo bếp đá cẩm thạch; cửa kính toàn cảnh phía sau bên phải; Vy đứng bên phải đảo bếp, Tùng bên trái.
scenes.props: Que thử thai hai vạch hồng, điện thoại của Vy (màn hình chỉ phát sáng), đảo bếp đá cẩm thạch trắng, cốc cà phê, chìa khóa xe và ví da của Tùng, bình lan trắng, túi xách trắng của Vy.
scenes.setting: A luxury high-rise apartment in the morning: a white marble kitchen island, a pale sofa, floor-to-ceiling windows over the city, glossy cold light.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: A lô, mày ơi, que này tao mượn của con bạn đang bầu đấy, hai vạch hồng hẳn hoi. Nó hỏi mượn làm gì, tao bảo mượn để mua nhà, mua cả chồng.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow rack focus from the test stick to her face
beats: Glossy cold morning light on a white marble kitchen island, a plastic pregnancy test stick showing two faint pink lines lying beside a cup of coffee and a vase of white orchids.
@Vy leans into frame at the island in her crimson dress with a glowing phone pressed to her ear, chatting into it with a lazy smile, her face and red lips clearly visible.
@Vy picks up the plastic pregnancy test stick showing two faint pink lines and twirls it between her manicured fingers like a tiny baton, still talking into the phone with a sly grin.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her lips, tucking the test stick into her small white handbag with a wink and lowering the glowing phone, the city skyline soft behind her.
clips.sfx: a faint city hum far below, an air conditioner whispering, a coffee cup set down on marble

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Anh ơi, mình có con rồi! Bác sĩ bảo chắc là con trai đấy anh.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Con trai à? Giỏi! Anh đặt tên luôn là Đại Phát, lớn lên làm giám đốc, đẹp trai giống bố.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot by the kitchen island, locked-off
beats: The marble kitchen island in cold morning light, a set of car keys and a leather wallet lying beside a coffee cup, the floor-to-ceiling windows glowing over the city.
@Vy holds out the plastic pregnancy test stick showing two faint pink lines to @Tung with one hand on her flat stomach and speaks sweetly with shining eyes, while he keeps his mouth closed.
@Vy finishes and closes her lips, and @Tung takes the stick, puffs out his chest and answers grandly, sweeping one open hand through the air as if unveiling a giant sign.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, smoothing his gelled hair in the window reflection with his chin up, while @Vy holds a sweet closed smile that tightens at one corner.
clips.sfx: the refrigerator humming, a soft gasp, a short proud laugh

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Đại Phát nhà mình không thể không có danh phận. Anh ly hôn đi, rồi sang tên căn nhà cho con.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Được, tuần này anh ly hôn. Nhà phố cổ anh sang tên cho em luôn, giám đốc nói là làm.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot, slow push-in
beats: @Vy sets the test stick down on the marble and lets her smile fade, laying her hand flat on the island, while @Tung still beams at her, both of them with their mouths closed.
@Vy speaks firmly to @Tung in a soft voice with a hard gaze, one red fingertip tapping the marble island in a steady rhythm, while he listens with his mouth closed.
@Vy finishes and closes her lips, and @Tung pats his own chest with an open palm and answers at once without a pause, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, chin lifted like a statue of himself, while @Vy lets a slow sweet closed smile spread back across her red lips.
clips.sfx: a fingernail tapping marble, the air conditioner humming

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Từ giờ em cứ nghỉ ngơi, đừng tự tay nấu cơm nữa kẻo mệt con anh.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Vâng, em nghe anh. Mà trước giờ toàn cơm quán dưới sảnh, em có nấu bữa nào đâu.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot by the window, slow push-in onto her face
beats: @Vy steps around the marble island and leans her head on @Tung's shoulder, her face turned toward the camera, both of them with their mouths closed in the glossy cold light.
@Tung speaks tenderly to @Vy with his hand over hers, gazing out at the city skyline, while she listens on his shoulder with a sweet closed smile.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @Vy answers sweetly, then turns her face away from him toward the camera and mutters the rest under her breath, her red lips clearly visible.
@Vy finishes muttering and closes her lips into a cold little smirk, rolling her winged eyes, while @Tung keeps gazing out of the window with a proud closed smile, noticing nothing.
clips.sfx: a faint city hum, a slow exhale, the air conditioner whispering

scenes.title: Cú Ngã Trên Cầu Thang
scenes.location: Bếp tầng trệt nhà ống của Thu, buổi chiều.
scenes.axis: Máy quay ở góc bếp nhìn về cửa trước; cầu thang dốc bên phải, bếp ga và nồi đồ xôi bên trái; Thu đứng cạnh bếp, Vy đứng gần bàn ăn rồi tự ngồi xuống bậc cầu thang dưới cùng; Tùng vào từ cửa trước.
scenes.props: Giỏ trái cây mây, khăn lau bát, nồi đồ xôi nhôm, chiếc camera nhỏ màu trắng trên kệ bếp cao (đèn xanh nhấp nháy).
scenes.setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Chị Thu ơi, em mang ít hoa quả sang chào chị cả đây, toàn quả nhập khẩu đấy chị.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Cảm ơn cô. Nhưng nhà này không có chị cả, chỉ có chủ nhà với khách không mời thôi.

clips.camera: 28mm wide shot from the kitchen toward the front door, slow push-in
beats: The ground-floor kitchen of the tube house in soft afternoon light, the big aluminum sticky-rice steamer on the gas stove, the steep tiled staircase on the right and the front door open.
@Vy steps in through the front door in her crimson dress with a wicker basket of fruit and calls out sweetly, while @Thu turns from the stove holding a dish towel, mouth closed.
@Vy finishes and closes her lips, and @Thu stays by the stove drying a bowl with the dish towel and answers her evenly with a calm half-smile, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, setting the dry bowl down neatly, while @Vy's smile stiffens and she lowers the fruit basket onto the wooden dining table.
clips.sfx: the alley outside, high heels on tiles, a wicker basket set down on wood

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Căn bếp này em sẽ cho dỡ đi làm quầy rượu, mùi xôi ám hết cả tường rồi.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Cô cứ vẽ tiếp đi, đẹp lắm. Chỉ thiếu mỗi cái sổ đỏ đứng tên cô thôi.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot across the kitchen, locked-off
beats: @Vy turns slowly in the middle of the kitchen, eyeing the walls and the staircase like a buyer at a viewing, while @Thu stands by the stove with the dish towel, both mouths closed.
@Vy sweeps one manicured hand across the stove and the steamer as if erasing them and speaks with a sweet smirk, while @Thu listens several steps away with her mouth closed.
@Vy finishes and closes her lips, and @Thu folds the dish towel in her hands and answers in a light, pleasant tone with a calm half-smile, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth and turns back to the stove, while @Vy's sweeping hand slowly drops to her side and her red lips press into a thin line.
clips.sfx: a dripping tap, a car engine pulling into the alley outside

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Ối đau quá, chị Thu ơi sao chị nỡ làm thế với em, anh Tùng ơi cứu con em với!

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Cô diễn thì diễn cho khéo. Tôi đứng cách cô ba mét, tay còn cầm cái khăn lau bát đây này.

clips.camera: 28mm wide shot from the kitchen corner, slow pull-back from the fruit basket to reveal the staircase and the stove
beats: A close view of the wicker fruit basket on the wooden dining table in the quiet afternoon kitchen, sunlight from the open front door lying across the tiles beyond it.
As the camera pulls back, @Vy is revealed already seated on the bottom stair, one hand holding her ankle and one on her flat stomach, wailing toward the front door, nobody near her.
@Vy finishes and closes her lips, and far across the kitchen by the stove, @Thu stands holding a dish towel in both hands and answers in a dry steady voice, lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, holding up the dish towel at arm's length as proof, while @Vy peeks toward the front door from under her lashes with her lips shut.
clips.sfx: a car door closing outside, the front gate creaking open, a dripping tap

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Cô làm gì cô ấy thế hả? Cô ấy đang mang thai Đại Phát của tôi đấy!

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Tôi không hề chạm vào cô ta. Anh không tin thì có trời biết, đất biết, và có người biết.

clips.camera: 35mm medium shot from beside the stove, slow tilt up toward the high kitchen shelf
beats: The bright front doorway of the tube house with the alley beyond, dust floating in the afternoon light and the steel gate standing half open.
@Tung strides in through the doorway in his charcoal suit, stops several steps away and points across the kitchen at @Thu, shouting, while she stands by the stove, mouth closed.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @Thu keeps her hands still on the towel and answers in a low steady voice, glancing up once toward the high kitchen shelf, lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, and the camera tilts up past her to the small white home camera on the high kitchen shelf, its tiny green light blinking steadily.
clips.sfx: the front gate clanging open, quick footsteps on tiles, a faint electronic beep

scenes.title: Mẹ Chồng Chọn Con Dâu
scenes.location: Tầng trệt nhà ống của Thu, buổi sáng một tuần sau.
scenes.axis: Máy quay ở phía bếp nhìn ra cửa trước; bàn ăn ở giữa, cầu thang bên phải, cửa trước sáng ở cuối hình; Na đứng cạnh túi đồ ở bậc cửa, bà Nhàn đi xuống từ cầu thang.
scenes.props: Đơn ly hôn (chữ mờ không đọc được), bút bi, thùng các-tông, túi vải đã đóng gói, chiếu cuộn, làn mây cũ và gậy tre của bà Nhàn.
scenes.setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Đơn tôi soạn sẵn rồi, luật sư giỏi nhất Hà Nội đấy. Cô ký vào đây cho xong.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Em ký đây. Nhà cửa em không lấy, chỉ xin nuôi con Na. Anh thuê luật sư giỏi thế, phí tiền quá.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot across the dining table, slow dolly across
beats: Morning light lies across the bare wooden dining table where a few pages with only faint unreadable lines of ink rest beside a cheap ballpoint pen, empty cardboard boxes stacked by the wall.
@Tung steps up to the table in his charcoal suit, taps the pages with one finger and speaks in a lofty businesslike tone, while @Thu sits on a low stool with her mouth closed.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @Thu picks up the pen, signs in one quick stroke without reading and answers him calmly with a dry half-smile, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, sliding the signed pages back across the table, while @Tung blinks down at them with his lips pressed shut and his finger still hovering in the air.
clips.sfx: a moped passing outside, paper rustling, a pen scratching on paper

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Cô còn gì muốn nói thì nói nốt đi, tôi còn đi họp.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: À, em để lại tờ giấy dặn cô ấy trên kệ bếp rồi: anh ngáy to, dị ứng tôm, tất vứt khắp nhà.

clips.camera: 85mm close-up two-shot, slow rack focus from his face to hers
beats: @Tung folds the signed pages into his inside jacket pocket and checks his gold wristwatch, while @Thu rises from the stool and smooths her apron, both of them with their mouths closed.
@Tung speaks curtly to @Thu with his chin up, tugging his cuffs straight, while she listens with her lips pressed shut and her hands folded in front of her apron.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, and @Thu answers him in a helpful matter-of-fact tone as if passing on a recipe, counting each item on her fingers, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth with a calm half-smile and turns away, while @Tung stands frozen with his eyebrows jumping up and his lips pressed shut.
clips.sfx: paper rustling, a car horn in the alley, a stool scraping on tiles

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Bà ơi, bà xách làn đi đâu thế ạ? Sáng nay bà đi chợ sớm à?

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Chợ gì. Bà đi theo mẹ cháu chứ đi đâu. Ở lại đây làm mẹ chồng kế toán Tuấn à?

clips.camera: 35mm medium shot toward the front door, slow pan from the stairs to the doorway
beats: The front doorway of the tube house in morning light, two packed cloth bags and a rolled straw mat waiting on the threshold beside the steep tiled staircase.
@Na stands by the packed bags in her school clothes and looks up at @BaNhan coming down the last stairs with an old rattan basket on her arm, asking her, lips clearly visible.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, and @BaNhan stops on the bottom step, leans on her bamboo walking stick and answers in a dry deadpan, her wrinkled face and lips clearly visible.
@BaNhan finishes speaking and closes her mouth, hooks the rattan basket higher on her arm and takes @Na's small hand, the two of them marching toward the bright alley with their chins raised.
clips.sfx: slow footsteps on the stairs, a walking stick tapping on tiles, the alley waking up

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Nhà to này mày cứ giữ. Mẹ chỉ mang theo cái gậy, cái làn, với đứa con dâu.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Đi hết càng tốt, nhà cửa yên tĩnh, mà sao vắng thế nhỉ? Tối nay ai nấu cơm?

clips.camera: 24mm wide shot from the foot of the stairs toward the front door, slow push-in on him
beats: The bright front doorway seen from inside the house, a strip of morning sun across the tiled floor, the cold stove and the sticky-rice steamer with no steam in the foreground.
@BaNhan stands in the doorway with her rattan basket and bamboo stick and speaks in profile without looking at @Tung, chin high, while he stands a few steps away, mouth closed.
@BaNhan finishes, closes her mouth and steps out into the alley, and @Tung, left alone, looks slowly around the bare kitchen and mutters to himself, his face and lips clearly visible.
@Tung finishes speaking and closes his mouth, lifts the lid of the cold empty rice pot on the stove and stares down into it, the open front door bright and empty behind him.
clips.sfx: a walking stick tapping away down the alley, a rooster far away, a pot lid clinking in the silence

scenes.title: Căn Phòng Trọ Mười Mét Vuông
scenes.location: Phòng trọ mười mét vuông trong xóm trọ chật chội ở Hà Nội, buổi tối mưa.
scenes.axis: Máy quay từ phía cửa nhìn vào; giường gỗ bên trái sát tường, bàn gấp bên phải dưới cửa sổ song sắt, chậu nhôm hứng dột ở giữa phòng.
scenes.props: Chậu nhôm hứng dột, nồi đồ xôi, túi vải, gói khăn tay đựng vàng của bà Nhàn, bức tranh sáp màu của Na, bóng đèn vàng, chiếu cói.
scenes.setting: A tiny rented room in a crowded Hà Nội boarding alley at night: a single wooden bed, a folding table, a small barred window, a hot plate, an aluminum basin catching drips from the leaking ceiling, a bare yellow bulb.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Mẹ ơi, phòng mình bé thế, con nằm xoay người một cái là chạm tường rồi.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Bé thì ấm con ạ. Mưa dột thì có cái chậu, coi như nhà mình có nhạc sống miễn phí.

clips.camera: 24mm wide shot from the doorway, slow push-in
beats: A tiny rented room at night under a bare yellow bulb, a single wooden bed against the wall and rain dripping from a dark ceiling stain into an aluminum basin.
@Na steps in hugging a small cloth bag, stretches both arms out between the bed and the wall and speaks to @Thu, while @Thu sets down the sticky-rice steamer with her mouth closed.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, and @Thu nudges the aluminum basin under the drip with her foot, cocks her head at the dripping sound and answers warmly with a playful half-smile.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, tapping a spoon on the basin rim in time with the drops, while @Na grins at her with a closed mouth and sways along to the rhythm.
clips.sfx: rain on a tin roof, water dripping into a metal basin, a spoon tinkling on a metal rim

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Mẹ giấu ít vàng kỹ đến mức thằng Tùng chưa tìm thấy bao giờ. Cầm lấy mở quán, coi như mẹ đầu tư.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Mẹ đầu tư vào con thì con không để mẹ lỗ đâu, lãi con trả bằng xôi.

clips.camera: 50mm medium two-shot beside the bed, slow push-in
beats: The edge of the wooden bed under the bare yellow bulb, a small knotted handkerchief bundle resting on the thin blanket, rain dripping into the basin beyond.
@BaNhan sits on the bed, unknots the handkerchief to show a few small gold rings and speaks to @Thu with a sly deadpan look, while @Thu kneels beside the bed, mouth closed.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, and @Thu takes the bundle in both rough palms, bows her head slightly and answers with a warm smile, her face and lips clearly visible.
@Thu finishes speaking and closes her mouth, while @BaNhan gives one brisk businesslike nod as if sealing a deal and pats the back of @Thu's hands, both smiling with closed lips.
clips.sfx: rain on the roof, the basin dripping, a cloth bundle rustling, gold rings clinking softly

clips.speaker: @Na
clips.line: Đây là bà, đây là mẹ, đây là con, ba người nắm tay nhau thật chặt. Còn bố thì con vẽ bé tí tẹo ở góc giấy, vì dạo này bố ở xa lắm.
clips.camera: 85mm close-up, slow tilt up from the crayon drawing to her face
beats: The folding table under the bare yellow bulb, a crayon drawing of three figures holding hands and one tiny figure in the far corner, with no words anywhere on the page.
@Na sits at the folding table in her school clothes, touching each of the three figures with a red crayon and whispering to herself, her face and lips clearly visible under the yellow bulb.
@Na moves the crayon to the tiny figure in the corner and keeps whispering, her lips clearly visible and her brow furrowed as she studies how small it is.
@Na finishes whispering and closes her mouth, then slowly adds a little red heart beside the tiny figure in the corner and looks at it with a small closed-mouth pout.
clips.sfx: a crayon scratching on paper, rain on the roof, the basin dripping

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Mẹ ơi, thế từ nay mẹ không phải thức chờ bố về nữa ạ?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Ừ, không chờ ai nữa. Mẹ con mình ngủ sớm, sáng mai còn khai trương gánh xôi mới, bà làm cổ đông.

clips.camera: 50mm medium shot from above the straw mat, slow push-in
beats: Faint streetlight from the small barred window lies across a straw mat and a thin blanket on the floor of the dark room, the bare bulb switched off and rain softening outside.
@Na lies on the straw mat beside @Thu under the thin blanket, both fully clothed, and whispers up to her mother sleepily, her lips visible in the streetlight, while @Thu keeps her mouth closed.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, and @Thu strokes her hair and whispers back with a faint smile, her face and lips visible in the streetlight, while @Na's sleepy eyes crinkle.
@Thu finishes whispering and closes her mouth and eyes, and mother and daughter sink into a deep sleep with slow even breathing, @Thu's hand resting open on the blanket.
clips.sfx: light rain, slow steady breathing, a distant moped

scenes.title: Chữ Ký Định Mệnh
scenes.location: Nhà cũ của Thu (Vy dọn vào), văn phòng giám đốc của Tùng và hầm xe dưới tòa nhà.
scenes.axis: Văn phòng: máy quay phía trước bàn làm việc trắng, Tùng ngồi ghế da bên trái, Vy đứng bên phải; hầm xe: máy quay nhìn qua kính chắn gió, Khải ngồi ghế lái bên trái, Vy ghế phụ bên phải.
scenes.props: Giấy ủy quyền (chữ mờ không đọc được), bút vàng, bìa hồ sơ trắng, quầy rượu gỗ sẫm, rèm nhung đỏ, xe sang đen không logo.
scenes.setting: A modern glass-walled director's office high in a Hà Nội tower: a large white desk with a family photo frame, a black leather chair, an architectural model of a residential tower, the city skyline beyond the windows.

clips.speaker: @Vy
clips.line: Gửi người đến sau: anh ấy ngáy to, dị ứng tôm, tất vứt khắp nhà. Chúc em may mắn nhé. Hừ, bà bán xôi này chọc mình đấy à, ơ, tất thật này!
clips.camera: 35mm wide shot of the remodelled kitchen, slow push-in toward her
beats: The ground-floor kitchen remodelled, a new dark-wood bar counter where the steamer used to stand, deep red velvet curtains over the window, a small folded note propped against a wine bottle.
@Vy in her crimson dress unfolds the small note, the paper showing only faint unreadable lines, and reads it aloud in a mocking sing-song voice, her face and red lips clearly visible.
@Vy scoffs, crumples the note in one hand and keeps talking, then stops short as her eyes drop to a bar stool where a crumpled grey man's sock lies draped over the velvet seat.
@Vy finishes speaking and closes her red lips, holding the grey sock up between two fingertips at arm's length, her nose wrinkled and her winged eyes narrowed.
clips.sfx: paper rustling, a scoff, high heels shifting on tiles, a loud snore rumbling down the staircase from upstairs
clips.setting: Inside a narrow three-storey tube house in a Hà Nội old alley: a ground-floor kitchen with a gas stove and a big aluminum sticky-rice steamer, a wooden dining table with low stools, a steep tiled staircase, a small family altar shelf, a small white home camera on a high kitchen shelf.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Anh ký vào giấy ủy quyền này, để em lo hết giấy tờ cho con.

turns.speaker: @Tung
